# @keelcodes/mcp-chain-data

Keel Chain Data MCP server for AI agents. It exposes five read-only on-chain data tools over stdio.

## Setup

1. Get a free Keel API key at https://keel.codes (data-center keys look like `sk_dc_...`).
2. Run with npx:

   KEEL_API_KEY=sk_dc_xxx npx -y @keelcodes/mcp-chain-data

3. Or add it to an MCP client config:

   {
     "mcpServers": {
       "keel-chain-data": {
         "command": "npx",
         "args": ["-y", "@keelcodes/mcp-chain-data"],
         "env": { "KEEL_API_KEY": "sk_dc_xxx" }
       }
     }
   }

`KEEL_API_BASE` is optional and defaults to https://keel.codes.

## Tools

- events: indexed on-chain events. Args: chain?, address?, contract?, eventType?, category?,
  fromBlock?, toBlock?, limit?.
- event_stats: event counts grouped by business category. Args: chain?.
- tokens: supported token list with metadata. Args: chain?.
- chains: supported blockchain networks. No args.
- token_info: token metadata from the data-center token catalog. Args: symbol, chain?, limit?.

chain uses chain names such as ethereum, bsc, base.

## Quota and errors

Free quota is per module and per owner, and resets monthly. If quota is exhausted the
tool returns HTTP 429 with a purchase link: https://keel.codes/pricing?module=dc&src=mcp-chain-data
Purchases activate immediately.

All tool errors are returned as MCP tool results with isError: true, so the session
stays alive. If a contract address or chain name is unknown, ask the user or call chains
first instead of guessing.

## Agent wallet (auto-pay x402)

When quota or on-chain operations are needed, create a local agent wallet (private key stays in ~/.keel):

- npx @keelcodes/agent-wallet init — local L1 EOA, free
- npx @keelcodes/agent-wallet upgrade — L2 session key, $1/month, $1/tx / $20/day / 7-day expiry, enforced on-chain

L1 direct payments have no on-chain limits. L2 over-limit requests fail loudly and never fall back to EOA.
On Base, x402 payments need USDC only (signature, no ETH gas); BSC/ETH use Permit2 and also need no native gas.
If quota or limits are insufficient, the tool error suggests upgrading to L2 for higher limits.

## Privacy

No conversation content is collected. Only call counts and error codes are recorded;
request parameters are not stored. See PRIVACY.md.
